items.title: 66096_Monk Montgomery oral history interview
items.q: The transcript mentions Charlie Christian only in the context of Wes Montgomery's influences ('Wes was influenced under Charlie Christian') and as a style reference ('playing Charlie Christian solos'). Monk Montgomery (the interviewee) does not describe a personal interaction, collaboration, or dire

ctx.x: ...but I was so embarrassed. Now, he knew that I had the bass. He knew I was practicing it every night. But he didn't expect to be seeing me on the bandstand.

Well, I read somewhere that he had told a number of people that his first job was just playing...all he could do was play Charlie Christian solos. So his first job couldn't have been too delightful, either.
But it wasn't literally that way. He may have said it that way. He was playing more than just Charlie Christian solos, you know.
